1.8 For this reason, the constructing of Ritual and Music by the former kings [was a matter of] making regulation for the people. The coarse hemp of mourning garments, crying and weeping -- these are what was used to regulate the mourning rites. Bells and drums, shields and axes -- these are what was used to harmonize peace and happiness. Marriages, caps and hairpins -- these are what was used to distinguish males and females. Archery contests and celebrations, banquet entertainments -- these are what was used to engage in proper social intercourse. Ritual regulates the people's hearts; Music harmonizes the people's voices. Administration is used to carry them out; Punishment is used to prevent [transgressions against] them. If the four develop and go unopposed, then the kingly Way is complete.

2.2 Music comes out from within, Ritual comes into being from without. Music comes out from within, thus it is still. Ritual comes into being from without, thus it is ordered. Great Music must be marked by ease, Great Ritual must be marked by simplicity.90 If Music reaches the ultimate, there are no grievances. If Ritual reaches the ultimate, [the people] do not struggle [with one another]. The governance of all under Heaven through deference is what is meant by Ritual and Music. Rebellious people do not arise, the feudal lords submit like guests, weaponry and armour are not employed, and the five punishments are not made use of. The masses are without suffering, and the Son of Heaven is not angry. -- If it is like this, then Music has reached its goal. Uniting the affections of father and son, making manifest the order of the old and the young, so as to gain respect for the Son of Heaven throughout the land -- if it is like this, then Ritual has been carried out.

For those whose accomplishments are great, their Music is complete; for those whose rule is [established] everywhere, their Ritual is complete. Dances of shields and axes are not complete Music. Sacrificing with well-boiled [foods] is not [fully-] attained Ritual. The five emperors in their different times did not follow each other in Music. The three kings in their different eras did not cloak themselves in each other's Ritual. When Music reaches the extreme, there is sorrow. When Ritual is coarse, there is bias. Flowing without rest, and uniting together in transformation, Music arises therein. In spring it is born, and in summer it grows --this is humanity (ren). In autumn it is harvested, and in winter it is stored

this is humanity (ren). In autumn it is harvested, and in winter it is stored -- this is propriety (yi). Humanity is close to Music; propriety is close to Ritual. Music promotes harmony, abides by the spirits, and follows Heaven. Ritual distinguishes what is appropriate, resides with the ghosts, and follows Earth. Thus sages created Music to respond to Heaven, and constructed Ritual to match the Earth. When Ritual and Music are illuminated and complete, then Heaven and Earth have obtained to [the world of] affairs.

Thus wine and food are what is used to unite men in enjoyment. Music is what is used to [cause the people] to strive to resemble the virtue [of the ruler]. Ritual is what is used to put a stop to transgressions. For this reason, when the former kings experienced a great loss (death), they invariably had ritual by which to mourn it. When they experienced a great blessing, they invariably had ritual by which to enjoy it. The division between mourning and enjoyment all ends in Ritual. Music -- it is what sages delight in, and it can be used to make better the hearts of the people. Its effect on people is deep; it can alter habits and change customs. Thus the former kings made manifest their teachings therein.

[In Music] they made it accord with the harmony of the [dual] breaths of life, and be a pathway for the movement of the five constancies.116 It was made to [exhibit] the power of yang, yet not be scattered, and the nature of yin, yet not be constricted; [so that its] inflexible energy (gangqi J R) would not [give rise to] anger, and its pliant energy (rouqi R Z ) would not [result in] timidity. [These] four penetrations (sichang e 9 f) interact within [Music?] and blossom forth without.
